title: Player Detector on Render
description: A simple Fabric mod for Minecraft automatically checks for players within your render distance.
body:
A simple Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that automatically checks for players within your render distance.

**⚠️ Before using this mod, make sure it is allowed by your server's rules. Some servers may consider player-detection modifications unfair or prohibited.**

Features
• Detects players inside your render distance.
• Real-time player monitoring.
• Displays information about nearby players.
• Lightweight and optimized for performance.
• Easy to use with no complex setup required.

If you experience crashes or errors, please send a screenshot of the error to my Discord: nx_deasun

The mod continuously scans for players that enter your render distance, making it useful for multiplayer servers where you want to know when other players appear nearby.

Requirements
• Minecraft 1.20.1
• Fabric Loader
• Fabric API
